title: Real-Time Model Predictive Control Algorithms for Autonomous Spacecraft Guidance
summary: This report studies and compares four families of Model Predictive Control (MPC) algorithms for autonomous spacecraft rendezvous guidance: Linear MPC, Tube MPC, Fast/Embedded MPC, and Successive Convexification (SCvx).
